summary: Iteration 4 testing of OpenCode Zen as 7th Co-Pilot provider. Backend: 78/78 pytest pass (16 iter4 + 21 iter3 + 15 iter2 + 26 iter1) in 71s — covers schema defaults, provider validation (opencode_zen accepted / bogus 400), opencode_api_key masking + masked-PUT preservation, NEW /api/tenants/me/copilot/models endpoint (live fetch, >=18 models, multimodal flags correct, 5-min cache, refresh forces fresh, gemini provider returns empty+note), chat handler graceful 401 with fake key, config-message on empty key, RBAC 403 for non-admin PUT, regression on real Gemini reply / dashboard / documents list / iter3 fields. Frontend: Settings page provider dropdown shows all 7 options including opencode_zen; selecting it reveals copilot-opencode-config block with all 5 data-testids (baseurl/apikey/model-select/fetch-btn/timeout); clicking 'Fetch models' populates dropdown with 18 entries and renders opencode-catalogue panel with 3 green (multimodal) + 15 grey (text-only) dots. Real OpenCode Zen /v1/models live fetch verified end-to-end.

critical_code_review_comments: OpenCode Zen schema additions (opencode_base_url default 'https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1', opencode_api_key, opencode_model default 'deepseek-v4-pro', opencode_timeout default 60) all properly defaulted and returned on GET — verified.

Provider validator extended to 7 values; 'opencode_zen' accepted, 'bogus' returns 400 with detail listing all 7 providers — verified.

_copilot_opencode handler: routes through OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions, vision_capable whitelist = {mimo-v2-omni, mimo-v2.5-pro, minimax-m3}, only attaches image for those; empty key returns config message; HTTPStatusError caught as 'OpenCode Zen error {code}'; generic Exception as 'OpenCode Zen request failed' — never raises 5xx. Verified with fake key → 401 path returns graceful 200 string reply.

NEW endpoint GET /api/tenants/me/copilot/models?provider=opencode_zen[&refresh=true]: live fetches https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/models, returns {provider, models:[{id,owned_by,created,multimodal}], cached, fetched_at}; _OPENCODE_MODEL_CACHE keyed by tenant_id::base_url with 5-min TTL — verified cached=true on 2nd call, refresh=true forces fresh.
Real LIVE call to opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/models from container succeeds (no auth needed for catalogue endpoint, returns 18+ models).

Frontend Settings.jsx: all 7 dropdown options + OpenCodeBlock component renders 5 data-testids; Fetch button hits /copilot/models and renders catalogue panel with green-dot (multimodal) vs grey-dot styling — verified with 3 green + 15 grey dots for current 18-model catalogue.
